title: Fair Measure
logline: At a weekly market, one trader's old balance scales are the only ones nobody double-checks, and a neighbouring stallholder's quiet suggestion to shave a little weight off gets a flat no.
human_question: What does it look like to keep doing the harder, honest thing when the easier dishonest one is right there, unnoticed?

situation.what_happens: A trader works an ordinary market day: setting up, weighing, selling, arguing about price, packing away. Inside that rhythm the chance to take a little more than is owed is constantly available and almost never visible — a thumb, a weight, a rounding. On at least one occasion the shortcut is put to the trader directly, by a neighbour or by circumstance, and is turned down. Nothing about the day marks the moment as important.
situation.who_is_involved: A trader with an established position and regular customers; neighbouring stallholders whose practices differ; customers, some of whom check and some of whom do not; and anyone whose work puts other people's money or goods through their hands, where the same refusal happens once rather than weekly.
situation.what_is_at_stake: For the trader, margin that is genuinely thin, and a reputation that is the business. For the neighbours, being implied to be cheats. For the viewer, whether an honest trade is the same thing as the moment of refusing to cheat.
situation.how_it_unfolds: Market days repeat on a fixed cycle, and the pressures are price, spoilage, competition and a bad week. The refusals are unremarked and quickly over; they may happen several times in a day or not at all. The same shape appears in one-off form wherever somebody finds property that is not theirs and spends unpaid hours returning it. Reality decides whether a real test occurs while anyone is watching, and what the trader says about it afterwards, if anything.

concept_merge.why_together: C024 makes the point the situation exists for: right livelihood is not 'having a decent job' but the actual refusal of a wrong way of earning, and the source says a naturally blameless trade is not this abstinence at all. C027 supplies the timing: in ordinary minds an abstinence arises occasionally and one at a time, only while a particular wrong is being held back from, and many good acts involve no restraint whatsoever. Together they locate the good moment precisely inside an otherwise unremarkable day.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: That honesty, in this account, is not a background trait a person has but a series of small refusals that happen and are over, and that most of a good person's day contains none of them.

concept_links.why: Right livelihood is the conscious refusal of a specific wrong done for a living; the source states that naturally blameless trade on its own is not this abstinence [C024-P:L45]. It also distinguishes three depths: stopping in the moment with no prior vow because the harm is suddenly seen [C024-P:L61], keeping an undertaking even at cost, and a change deep enough that the wrong no longer arises.

In the wholesome sense-sphere minds the abstinences arise only occasionally and separately, when a specific wrong is actually being refrained from, unlike the supramundane minds where all three are present together [C027-P:L41; C027-M:L17]; the digest adds that giving, bowing and listening involve no abstinence at all.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: Being honest is not only a background trait: the texts describe a specific good moment that happens when a person has a real chance to cheat and turns it down.
what_must_be_real: An actual market day and the trader's actual, ongoing practice. No staged temptation, no arranged test, and no neighbour recruited to offer a shortcut.
position_hint: middle, early: it follows plain giving with the first complication — that goodness can be a refusal rather than an act.
risks: Implying that other traders cheat, which would be unfair without evidence
Staging a temptation, which would falsify the premise entirely
Treating one refusal as proof of a whole character, which the sources do not support
drop_if: No trader's real, ongoing practice can be observed without staging
No genuine refusal is observed and the film would have to imply one

connections.note: IDEA-0101's found-and-returned property is folded in here as the one-off form of the same refusal, the restraint that arises with no prior vow.
Both concern honest dealing chosen over an available and more profitable wrong, at the level of a trade and of a community.

selection.reason: Used by its episode and the more filmable of the two restraint situations; IDEA-0101's momentary restraint is folded in.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
